en-US.description: A lossless Windows desktop app for DeepSeek Harness with the complete DSH Web UI, plugins, skins, and skill dock.
en-US.longDescription: DeepSeek Harness Desktop packages the original DSH Web surface as a native Windows application while retaining the official runtime and complete dsh-web-ui plugin and skin collection, with an isolated desktop profile and a hardened Electron renderer.
en-US.releaseNotes:
DeepSeek Harness Desktop 5.2.0
Windows x64、macOS arm64、Linux x64 同版发布。macOS/Linux 保持 Preview；所有安装包未签名，macOS 未公证。
更新内容
- 官方 NPM Runtime/SDK 使用 0.2.1-rc.4；本次适配观察时它是 next 候选，latest 为 0.2.1-rc.2，不称为官方稳定版。保留官方皮肤默认值、用户已保存的皮肤、会话、模型提供方和扩展配置。
- 集中修复桌面共用侧栏布局，针对所有皮肤出现的左下角空栏，保留底部功能入口与侧栏展开、折叠能力。
- 接入 GitHub 插件合集中的预测下一句、鲸鱼娘全身桌宠与操控浏览器。三个原始 tgz 的大小与 SHA-256 均匹配公开资产；适配代码独立放在自有插件和桌面宿主中，不修改官方源码或原始插件压缩包。
- 既有桌宠、AionUI、官方浏览器提供方、技能入口、第三方 API 和托盘驻留继续保留。浏览器增加受校验的专用子进程入口，避免打包后重复启动主工作台。
- 桌宠自动避让输入区，保留用户原始位置，修复位置镜像异步乱序；修复 profile 合并时配对服务挂载和中断迁移恢复晚于配置读取的问题。机械盘冷启使用有界等待，避免过早重试。
- 自定义供应商先确认首次 Key 保存再提交配置；写入失败时保留草稿并明确提示，避免留下没有 Key 的供应商。已经丢失且没有备份的 Key 仍需重新填写。
验证与下载
正式标签 desktop-v5.2.0 指向 c64c9521f3dc15269a0504a3bfa4fc743b542983。正式三端验证与发布记录：GitHub Actions。
正式标签同一提交的三端原生验收全部通过：Windows 桌面测试 2239 项、脚本测试 237 项，零失败、零跳过；源码回归 32/32、随包回归 47/47，无 accepted issue。真实 Setup 覆盖 4.3.0、5.0.0、5.0.1、5.1.0，共 8 个安装/升级场景、12 个已安装 Runtime 阶段、24 次通过鉴权的合成本地请求；旧会话、供应商配置、凭据与重启保留检查通过。macOS/Linux 各 2172 项桌面测试通过、零失败，67 项既有 Windows 专用跳过名称一致且未新增；脚本测试各 237 项，原生构建、完整性及随包冒烟通过。
五个正式安装文件及全部 12 个附件已独立下载并核对实际 SHA-256，与本次正式原生收据、GitHub 资产摘要、合并校验表和发布清单一致；五个安装链接的匿名访问与 latest 更新入口均已验证。Windows 实际公开 Setup 为 NotSigned。已安装 Runtime 的推理验收使用合成本地服务，不代表付费供应商线上验收。
首次 Windows 原生安装 fixture 在原始 20 秒准备期限处超时，原始日志和产物保留；同一提交的一次诊断重跑完成全部门禁，未修改测试断言、超时或标签。该准备超时的根因未证实。
下载下方 EXE、DMG/ZIP 或 AppImage/DEB，并核对本 Release 的合并 SHA256SUMS.txt 与 release-manifest.json。正式构建哈希以本页文件为准，不能使用发版前预检包的哈希。同号 5.2.0 本地候选用户请手动下载正式包覆盖，不承诺同号自动更新。Windows 可能提示未知发布者；macOS/Linux 的原生 Runner 验证不代表所有物理设备或系统版本均已验收。
托盘退出历史超时在本轮未重现，根因尚未证实。所有适配使用官方 NPM SDK 与 profile/Cordis patch；保留既有用户配置、会话与插件。本次发布为 GitHub Desktop 安装文件，不包含 NPM 发布。
English
- Use public official NPM Runtime/SDK 0.2.1-rc.4. At the adaptation observation it was the next candidate while latest was 0.2.1-rc.2; this is not an official stable-runtime claim. Keep the official default skin and saved skin choices, conversations, providers and plugin preferences.
- Address the shared Desktop sidebar layout behind the reported lower-left empty strip across skins while preserving footer actions and expanded or collapsed navigation.
- Integrate Prompt Pilot, the full-body companion and the visible browser from the public GitHub plugin bundle. Original tarball sizes and SHA-256 digests match the release assets. Compatibility code remains separate from the immutable archives and official source.
- Retain the existing companion, AionUI, official browser providers, skill controls, third-party API configuration and background residency. A validated browser subprocess entry prevents a packaged executable from launching another main workbench.
- Keep companions clear of the composer without overwriting intended positions, and serialize asynchronous position mirrors. Restore pairing-service composition and recover interrupted migration before reading configuration. A bounded disk-startup budget avoids premature retries.
- Confirm a new custom provider's first Key save before committing its configuration. A refused write retains the draft and shows a clear error rather than leaving a provider without its Key. An already lost Key with no backup still needs to be entered again.
Validation and downloads
Formal tag: desktop-v5.2.0, source commit c64c9521f3dc15269a0504a3bfa4fc743b542983. Native validation and publication: GitHub Actions.
The same-commit formal tag passed all three native jobs. Windows passed 2,239 Desktop tests and 237 script tests with zero failures or skips, source regression 32/32 and packaged regression 47/47, with no accepted issues. Actual Setup acceptance covered 4.3.0, 5.0.0, 5.0.1 and 5.1.0: eight install/upgrade scenarios, 12 installed Runtime phases and 24 authenticated synthetic loopback requests, including retained conversations, providers, credentials and restart behavior. Each macOS/Linux native job passed 2,172 Desktop tests and 237 script tests; the same 67 existing Windows-only skips remain unchanged. Native packaging, integrity and packaged smoke checks passed.
All five formal installation files and all 12 public attachments were independently downloaded and hashed. Actual SHA-256 values match this formal run's native receipts, GitHub asset digests, combined checksums and release manifest. Anonymous installation links and the latest updater endpoint were verified. The actual public Windows Setup is NotSigned. Installed Runtime inference acceptance uses synthetic loopback services and does not establish paid-provider online validation.
The first Windows native installer fixture exceeded its original 20-second preparation budget. Its original logs and artifacts are retained. One diagnostic rerun of the unchanged commit completed all gates without changing assertions, deadlines or the tag. No root-cause fix is claimed for that preparation timeout.
Verify installation assets against the combined SHA256SUMS.txt and release-manifest.json attached to this Release. Preflight candidate hashes do not certify these rebuilt release assets. All builds are unsigned; macOS is unnotarized. macOS/Linux remain Preview. Same-version local candidate users should download and overlay the formal build manually. Synthetic loopback acceptance does not establish paid-provider online validation. The historical tray timeout was not reproduced; no root-cause fix is claimed.
